tool_args.rationale: The supply-bullwhip bridge maps to the inland-hub siphon, but the fixed-gradient pilot cannot determine its sink inhibition. The open-branch probe targets this genuine identifiability ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five observations have the same sink gradient, so sink inhibition is not identifiable; the branch sign also needs discrimination.
The bridge signature points to the static inland-hub siphon, not a coupled memory ODE; this costlier trajectory batch is not the targeted test.
It does not resolve the relevant branch or sink-gradient ambiguity.
